\section*{Supplement: what the integer field is for}
\label{sec:compatible}

On the published training half the counting field reaches 0.8045 ROC-AUC and the logistic regression 0.8008. The paired gap is +0.0038, interval [-0.0057, +0.0125], which contains zero. That is the manuscript's sentence, reproduced here before anything else was read. Mean ROC-AUC is not where these two objects differ, so the rest of this note measures the places they do.

The field score on the pick half reconstructs from 4853 integer multiplicities with maximum absolute error 0.00e+00. Those multiplicities are 41216 bytes. The logistic coefficient vector is 5168 bytes and does not decompose into a cell.

Top-decile capture, the share of a chain's cryptic residues that sit in the top tenth of its own ranking, is 0.4411 for the field and 0.4439 for the logistic, a paired gap of -0.0028 with interval [-0.0155, +0.0096] over 384 chains. The tenth is fixed; it was not chosen after the fact.
